Camelot Portfolios Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 27.94% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Camelot Portfolios Llc sold 7,379 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 19,033 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $3.19M, down from 26,412 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Camelot Portfolios Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $913.28 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.19% or $0.35 during the last trading session, reaching $185.81. About 11.17 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 22, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
